The Premises leased to Lessee by Lessor are as follows: approximately 558 square feet certain real property located inside the Market House of the Nashville Farmers’ Market (further identified in the Market House Lease Plan at Attachment 1) as well as the refrigeration unit within that space. The Premises shall include only the appurtenances specifically granted in this lease with Lessor specifically excepting and reserving for itself, the roof, the air space above the roof, the space below the floor slab, above any dropped ceilings and two feet below the roof deck, the exterior portions of the Premises (other than a storefront). Lessor reserves the right to install, maintain, use, repair and replace pipes, ductwork, conduits, utility lines, and wires as well as conduct pest control and extermination in the Premises. Lessor further reserves the right to conduct pest control and extermination in the Premises at regular intervals and as needed. Lessor agrees that where possible all work in the Premises shall be performed in a manner which shall not unreasonably interfere with the normal business operations of Lessee. LEASE 20130828 ARCHIVE
(b) Additional Area. Lessee use and occupation of the Premises shall include the right to ingress to and egress from the Premises and shall include a revocable license to use in common with the others entitled thereto, the Common Areas, as may be designated from time to time by Lessor, subject however to the terms and conditions of this Lease and to rules, guidelines, and facility-use policies relating to the use thereof as prescribed from time to time by Lessor. The term “Common Areas” as used in this Lease shall mean all Nashville Farmers’ Market space and facilities furnished and designated by the Lessor for the general use, in common, by visitors and customers or renters, including Lessee, its officers, agents, employees. Said space and facilities may include, but are not limited to, the parking areas, streets, passenger vehicle roadways, sidewalks, walkways, service areas, roadways, loading platforms, drainage and plumbing systems, roof, canopies, ramps, landscaped areas and other similar facilities available for common use which may from time to time exist. Lessor reserves the right at any time to relocate buildings, sheds, parking areas, and other Common Areas, to change the number of buildings, building dimensions, the number of floors in any of the buildings, the Common Areas, the identity and type of other stores and tenancies, and to construct other buildings or improvements, provided only that the general location and size of the Premises, reasonable access to the Premises and the parking facilities shall not be materially impaired. Lessor shall have no obligation to permit any of the Common Areas to be operated beyond the normal, Nashville Farmers’ Market hours of operation. All Common Areas, which Lessee may be permitted to use, shall be used under a revocable license, and if the amount of the Common Areas is diminished, Lessor shall not be subject to any liability nor shall Lessee be entitled to any compensation or diminution or abatement of rent, nor shall such decrease of the Common Areas be deemed constructive or actual eviction. (c) Acceptance. Lessor makes no representation of any nature in connection with the condition of the Premises, and Lessor shall not be liable for any latent or patent defect therein. Lessor and Lessee hereby agree that Lessee’s possession of the Premises on the begin date of this Lease shall be deemed conclusive evidence of Lessee’s acceptance of the Premises as being in satisfactory condition and in full compliance with all covenants and obligations of Lessor in connection therewith. Lessee agrees that it will accept possession of the Premises in an “as is” condition and that no representations or inducements respecting the condition of the Premises have been made to Lessee by Lessor or its authorized representatives. Similarly, Lessee hereby acknowledges that no promises to decorate, alter, repair, or improve the Premises, either before or after the execution hereof, have been made by Lessor or its authorized representatives. (d) Site Preparation. Lessee shall not construct, install, build, fashion, connect, remodel structures within or otherwise permanently modify the Premises without Lessor’s prior, written approval in each instance. Any such modification without written consent shall be subject to removal without notice at any time at Lessee’s sole cost. Upon Lessor and any other required approval, Lessee shall complete any site work on the Premises in accordance with Design and Construction Criteria established by Lessor for the subject Premises. Lessee shall install within the Premises only such fixtures and equipment as detailed at Attachment 2 hereto or which Lessor may subsequently approve in writing. (e) Hours of Operation. Lessee hereby agrees and covenants that Lessee shall only be open for business within the hours that the Market House is open to the public. (1) The Nashville Farmers’ Market property may be closed to the public and Licensee on: New Year's Day, Thanksgiving Day, and e = Christmas Day. Lessor reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to close the Market House to the public and require Lessee to close operations on other federal or local holidays or on other publicly appointed days as might such be deemed in the best interest of Nashville Farmers’ Market operation. (2) The Market House outside doors will be unlocked and the facility will be open to the public, typically, during the hours of 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.. However, Lessor reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to adjust the hours when the Market House is open to the public. LEASE 20130828 ARCHIVE
(3) Lessor reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to close the Market House to the public on any day after 3:00 p.m. for special events held in or other use of the Market Housé Common Areas. In such instances, whether Lessee must close operations or may remain open for business during such hours shall be at Lessor’s sole determination. (4) Closure of Lessee’s business pursuant to this Section 2(e) shall NOT entitle Lessee to any abatement or decrease of Rent or relieve Lessee from any of its obligations under this Lease or impose any liability on Lessor by reason of inconvenience or annoyance to Lessee or injury to or interruption of Lessee's business or otherwise.

(f) Lessee shall not leave any type of vehicle or trailer anywhere on Lessor property with the exception of vehicles used for personal transportation and moved to and from the property each day (parking any such vehicles shall be subject to all relevant Nashville Farmers’ Market guidelines and policies). (g) No alcohol shall be sold or served by Lessee and none shall be consumed in the Premises unless Lessee meets relevant licensure and additional insurance requirements and this Lease is properly amended to permit such.

SECTION 5, PAYMENT TERMS (a) Payments. Rent shall be due and payable monthly in advance, on or before the first day of each calendar month. This Section 5 shall be deemed adequate notification of Rent requirements, and Lessor shall be under no obligation to invoice Lessee for said payments. Lessee shall pay Rent to Lessor as well as any and all additional sums to be paid by Lessee to Lessor under this Lease, without demand, deduction or setoff, at Lessor’s address detailed in this Lease or as otherwise specified by Lessor in writing. (1) Lessee shall make all payments by check, cashier’s check, money order, or credit/debit card (if Lessee has a personal check returned for insufficient funds, Lessor will not accept personal checks for future payments). Lessor will not accept cash payments. (2) Aconvenience fee will be added to credit/debit card payments in accordance with Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County regulations. (3) Lessee shall make ALL payments to Lessors’ business office during the hours and on the days specified by relevant Nashville Farmers’ Market guidelines and policies (e.g., Monday through Thursday between the hours of 8:00 a.m. ~ 10:00 a.m., and 1:00 p.m. — 3:00 p.m.). Payments sent by U.S. Mail or courier service must be received by Lessor on or before the due date. Lessor will assume no responsibility for delays or delivery failures. (b) Rent. Notwithstanding the begin date or the effective date of this Lease, Rent for the Premises described herein shall be due and payable monthly in advance, on or before the first day of each calendar month beginning December 1, 2013, and in accordance with the following. (1) During the period December 1, 2013, and end May 31, 2014, the Rent due and payable for the Premises shall be TWO THOUSAND AND ONE HUNDRED DOLLARS ($2,100.00), per month. (2) In the event that Lessee becomes a tenant from month-to-month pursuant to Section 1(c), above, Lessee shall pay Rent for the Premises in an amount each month equal to the final monthly Rent payable pursuant to this Lease plus fifteen percent (15%). NOTE: For purposes of this Lease, "month" shall be defined as a calendar month. The pro rata Rent for any partial month during the term of this Lease shall equal the product of 1/30th of the monthly Rent amount in effect during the partial month and the number of days in the partial month for which Rent is owed. LEASE 20130828 ARCHIVE

All other charges, including but not limited to Lessee assessments provided hereunder, shall be due and payable by Lessee on or before the first day of the calendar month following Lessor demand, invoice, or other any other notice of said charges; and, Lessor shall have the same remedies for failure to pay same as for a non-payment of Rent. (1) (2) (3) (4) (5) (6) Security Deposit— The FIVE HUNDRED DOLLAR ($ 500.00) Security Deposit paid by the Lessee pursuant to prior leases (originally for the period December 13,2012, through June 12, 2013) shall be held by Lessor to secure Lessee's performance of its obligations under this Lease. The Security Deposit is not an advance payment of Rent or a measured limit of Lessor’s damages resulting from any cause, including but not limited to an event of default. Lessor may, from time to time and without prejudice to any other remedy, use all or a part of the Security Deposit to perform any obligation Lessee fails to perform hereunder. Following any such application of the Security Deposit, Lessee shall pay to Lessor on demand the amount so applied in order to restore the Security Deposit to its original amount. Provided that Lessee has performed all of its obligations hereunder, Lessor shall, after the Lease ends, return to Lessee the portion of the Security Deposit which was not applied to satisfy Lessee obligations. The Security Deposit may be commingled with other funds, and no interest shall be paid thereon. If Lessor transfers its interest in the Premises and the transferee assumes Lessor’s obligations under this Lease, then Lessor may assign the Security Deposit to the transferee and Lessor thereafter shall have no further liability for the return of the Security Deposit. Property Damage— Lessee shall pay for any and all damage to Lessor property or equipment or the property of any person resulting from the activities or use of the Premises or Lessor property by Lessee or Lessee’s employees, agents, contractors, members, licensees, customers, or invitees. Late Charge— Lessee hereby agrees that all sums due and owing to Lessor for Rent or any other amount owed hereunder shall be paid in full as detailed herein and agrees that, upon any failure to render payment by the fifth (s") day of each applicable month during the Term, Lessee shall be subject to the assessment of a FIFTY DOLLAR ($50.00) Late Charge, as and for liquidated damage. Such charge shall be due immediately, along with the associated payment(s). Lessee further agrees that, in each instance that a balance of any amount is carried from one calendar month into the next, Lessee shall be subject to the assessment of a TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTY DOLLARS ($250.00) Late Charge, as and for liquidated damage. Improper Use of Common Areas— In the event that Lessee or Lessee employees place any Lessee equipment, inventory, merchandise, or other Lessee owned item in any location exterior to the Premises (reference Section 7(b)(10)), Lessor, at its option, may charge Lessee FIFTY DOLLARS ($50.00) per day per item until Lessee removes all such items, as and for liquidated damage. Improper Handling of Refuse or Recyclable Material— Lessee and Lessee employees must comply with Lessor requirements relating to handling of garbage and recyclable material (e.g., all garbage taken to the refuse removal bin must be in securely tied garbage bags; no refuse may be placed in or around the Market House loading dock). In the event of non-compliance with any such requirement, Lessor, at its option, may charge Lessee FIFTY DOLLARS ($50.00) per infraction, as and for liquidated damage. Non-Compliance with Delivery or Loading Dock Requirements— The delivery of any items to and from the Premises shall be subject to all such facility-use policies as in the judgment of Lessor are necessary for the proper operation of the Premises and the Nashville Farmers’ Market. All loading and unloading of goods shall be done only at such times, in the areas, and through the entrances designated for such purposes by Lessor. Loading Dock use shall be subject to the requirements detailed in Section 7(b)(3) ARCHIVE
hereto. In the event of non-compliance with any delivery or loading dock requirement, Lessor, at its option, may charge Lessee FIFTY DOLLARS ($50.00) per infraction, as and for liquidated damage. Additionally, Lessee hereby acknowledges that, if Lessee is charged for non-compliance with any combination of delivery or loading dock requirements on three (3) different dates, Lessor, at Lessor’s sole discretion and notwithstanding any associated fee, charge or penalty, may deem such a Breach of License to operate at the Nashville Farmers’ Market subjecting Lessee to the loss of any or all privileges. (7) Attorney’s Fees— In the case of Lessee failure to perform and comply with any of the covenants and conditions of this Lease, Lessee agrees to pay to Lessor the costs and expenses of enforcing this contract including a reasonable sum for attorney’s fees and related expenses, whether suit be brought or not. (8) Other Fees and Charges— In addition to the amounts detailed herein, Lessor, at its option, may also impose on Lessee and Lessee shall be liable for any fees or charges detailed in and permitted by the Nashville Farmers’ Market rules and facility-use policies. Notwithstanding any fines, fees, or charges of any type for violations of requirements detailed or referenced herein, Lessee violation of Nashville Farmers’ Market rules and facility-use policies or of metropolitan ordinances, health and building codes, or state and federal laws, at Lessor’s sole judgment, may be considered a Breach of Contract and subject Lessee to the loss of any or all privileges, and such violation may be deemed to constitute an event giving rise to a termination of this Lease.
